profile.description: East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry provides coating services on pipes provided by the customers. The company provides steel pipes for water, oil, and gas applications; double jointing solutions; coated pipes for various applications, including environmental conditions; and ancillary services comprising laboratory and technical support services, as well as yard management systems. It is also involved in processing and polishing of metals. East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry was formerly known as Welspun Middle East Pipes LLC and changed its name to East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry in January 2021. East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry was founded in 2010 and is based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.
